prompt: Implement the class `IntervalSet` in solution.py: a set of integers stored as half-open intervals [start, end). The constructor takes no arguments. `add(start, end)` inserts every integer of the interval; `remove(start, end)` deletes them; `contains(value)` tests membership; `intervals()` returns the content as a list of (start, end) tuples sorted by start, in which no two intervals overlap or touch (touching intervals such as [1, 3) and [3, 5) are merged into (1, 5)); `len(obj)` gives the number of integers stored. `add` and `remove` raise ValueError when start > end and do nothing when start == end. Removing from the middle of an interval splits it in two.
acceptance: removing from the middle splits an interval
